prediction_ledger_observation.meaning: No live 2x forecast exists; this preflight creates none.

purpose: Freeze outcome-blind Cohort 001 coverage rules before any <=90d 2x labels or prospective candidates are opened.

evidence_authenticity.policy: A caller-supplied source ID, digest, timestamp or feature value is never sufficient to open labels. Every accepted evidence record must match retained immutable JSON bytes whose SHA-256 is recomputed by the gate. Derived evidence must bind transform ID/version, exact parameters and retained input digests. Critical cohort gates are deterministically recomputed from retained inputs.
evidence_authenticity.repair_reason: Independent review found that the original structural validator could accept a fabricated manifest carrying an allowed source ID and arbitrary caller value.

historical_universe_rule.selection: All historical spot USDT markets discoverable from pinned raw/archive/catalog evidence at each decision timestamp, subject only to the frozen PIT coverage/liquidity/identity gates. Do not start from today's symbol list.
historical_universe_rule.same_asset_overlap: Later 90d label stage must remove overlapping same-asset windows without looking at outcomes.
historical_universe_rule.delisted_and_censored: Retain explicitly; never convert missing/delisted outcomes into non-mover controls.

source_semantics.BINANCE_PUBLIC_DATA_SPOT_RAW: Eligible only when a retained raw/normalized evidence artifact is present under the trusted artifact root and its bytes reproduce the frozen SHA-256. Current exchange metadata cannot stand in for historical evidence.
source_semantics.COINMETRICS_COMMUNITY_SPLY_CUR: Eligible only for assets/dates where the community catalog proves SplyCur coverage and the retained response has a time/status-time compatible with the historical cutoff; missing coverage is missing, never imputed.
source_semantics.PIT_PRIMARY_FUNCTIONAL_CLASSIFIER_V1: Mechanical functional-role classification from primary launch/protocol documentation that was public by the decision timestamp. If role is ambiguous or changed, exclude the interval instead of applying today's category.
source_semantics.DERIVED_PRE_CUTOFF_VENUE_BARS_V1: Derived only from completed bars/trades timestamped no later than the decision cutoff. The evidence artifact must bind transform ID/version, parameters and retained input digests; raw caller values are insufficient.
source_semantics.DERIVED_BTC_MARKET_REGIME_V1: Frozen ex-ante market-regime rule computed only from BTC market data available by the same cutoff, with transform metadata and verified retained input digests.
source_semantics.TRAILING_30D_MEDIAN_QUOTE_VOLUME_USD_V1: Exactly the median of the previous 30 completed UTC daily venue quote-volume observations before decision_at. All 30 dates are mandatory. The validator recomputes the median from retained input artifacts; a current or one-day liquidity value cannot satisfy this field.
source_semantics.DERIVED_BINANCE_LISTING_AGE_DAYS_V1: Floor elapsed days from the retained first verified venue trade timestamp to decision_at, recomputed by the validator. Today's listing metadata cannot substitute.
source_semantics.DERIVED_BINANCE_HISTORICAL_MEMBERSHIP_V1: Historical member/tradable state at exactly decision_at from retained pre-outcome market-presence evidence. The validator recomputes the boolean from the retained input artifact.
